verdict.rationale: A public GitHub repo for the SDKs exists, and a community member states that the RCLI repo is MIT-licensed. However, community reports also say the core MetalRT inference engine is commercial and proprietary, so only part of the stack is readable under an open license. Missing for 10: a first-party license statement for the SDK repo, open source for the MetalRT engine and NeuRT kernel pipeline, and independent confirmation of which components are open.
